# Maven launcher provenance

Apache Maven Wrapper **3.3.4**, `only-script`, was downloaded from Maven Central over HTTPS and checked against its published SHA-1. Its Apache license headers are retained. No bootstrap jar is required.

Apache Maven **3.9.9** is pinned with SHA-256 in `maven-wrapper.properties`; the archive was also checked against Maven Central's published SHA-512.

Sources: [Wrapper distribution](https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/wrapper/maven-wrapper-distribution/3.3.4/), [Maven distribution](https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/3.9.9/), [Wrapper documentation](https://maven.apache.org/tools/wrapper/).
